text:
My boss: "No pressure, but..."

The pressure: unbelievable.

Nobody:

Absolutely nobody:

My boss at 4:58 PM: "Got a sec?"

Boss: "We need someone who handles pressure well."

Me: Oh. So YOU'RE the pressure.

Dear boss,

I'm not ignoring your 10 PM email.

I'm ignoring it professionally.

I don't need a vacation.

I need my boss to take one.

"Can you stay a little late?"

I could. But then I'd have to see you longer.

My work bestie and I don't talk in meetings.

One look and we've both quit in our heads.

Every meeting starts with "this will be quick."

Every meeting is a liar.

Me: I'm setting boundaries.

My boss: Cool. I'll just walk right past them.

Me at 9:00 AM: New day, new me.

Me at 9:07 AM, after one email from my boss: Never mind.

Rule #2

If you text me "you there?" on my day off...

I'm not. I never was.

My boss says we're a family.

That explains the yelling, the guilt trips and why nobody gets paid.

Sorry I'm late.

I was emotionally preparing for this meeting.

They didn't promote me.

They just gave me more work and called it "growth."
